title: crunch munch.WAV
author: daustin13
changes: Real close-up recording of a leaf being crunched by hand to sound like chewing, used for the caterpillar (a caterpillar's own leaf-munching is too quiet to record clearly). Trimmed to 0.05–2.40 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass: the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
